messages:
elaine: Heads-up 1: competitor pushed a per-tenant fallback routing feature this morning. Getting inbound questions from pilots. Thoughts: parity or take a different angle? :thinking:

sam: I saw it. Their fallback is basically route-to-smaller-model on load. Cheap but degrades quality in long-context cases. Feels like a low-effort shim.

anya: We should measure actual quality impact. I can run evals across 3 tenant archetypes if we decide to act.

divya: Sales: pilots are asking for predictable cost controls during spikes. If we don't have an option, RFQs will flag it.

mike: What about a policy-first approach: offer configurable fallback policies (latency-first, cost-first, quality-preserve). That mirrors parity but gives product differentiation.

tara: From telemetry: ~8% of requests in a specific burst profile are safe candidates for fallback (short contexts, prefix cached). We need user-facing regression curves before committing.

elaine: Proposed plan: 1) 1-week eval spike (anya + tara) to quantify quality delta for two fallback modes; 2) prototype routing toggle (sam + mike) scoped to Dedicated customers; 3) define launch gates and canary path.

sam: Proto plan: flag `route.fallback_policy` values {latency,cost,quality}. Decision in admission path, then select model variant. Canary behind FF. Rough estimate: 2 engineers x 2 sprints for minimal prototype.

anya: I'll produce 3 prompt sets per tenant type (chat, summarization, extraction). ETA 5 working days for baselines and initial deltas.

divya: If we gate to Dedicated/Private beta, ops and capacity are simpler and it's a sales motion: "policy-backed fallback controls". I can line up pilots if we commit to a 6-week beta timeline.

mike: UX: per-tenant toggle + default policy + API override. I can mock a tiny console flow and API spec in 48h. Sample API: `POST /v1/tenants/{id}/fallback` {"policy":"cost"}. Keep it minimal.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary cluster upgrade scheduled 2024-06-07T03:00Z.

elaine: Draft launch criteria (v0): quality regression <3% weighted, p95 latency improvement >15% in cost mode during bursts, console/API controls, canary + rollback within 15m, docs + sales one-pager ready.

tara: Add telemetry requirement: rolling 30m quality drift alert + automated rollback if >5% regression for top-3 tenants.

sam: Ops risk: multi-variant models complicate KV cache priming and invalidation. Budget +10% SRE effort for rollout. Watch memory/KV fragmentation.

elaine: Prioritization ask: I want a short cross-functional spike this sprint and a PRD-gate decision at next sync. If green, roadmap add = 2 eng sprints + 1 UX + evals.

divya: :thumbsup: I'll prepare pilot list and update sales materials if we greenlight.

anya: Starting evals today; will post results in this thread by EOD Friday.

sam: I'll allocate one engineer to pair with mike next sprint for the scaffold. We'll aim for a FFed canary endpoint.

mike: Dropping figma & mini-API spec in 48h.

elaine: Goal for PRD sync: metric-backed rec (parity shim vs policy-led product), dev estimate, and go/no-go for Dedicated beta. If green, we add a small cross-team slice to Q3 roadmap.

ops-bot: reminder: PRD sync 2024-06-10 16:00 UTC.

elaine: Thanks all 1 1 If anyone expands scope or constraints, post here and I'll fold into the PRD."
